title: Velocity after acceleration
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) correctly states the speed as v_0 = sqrt(2eU_1/m).

title: Displacement in field
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) correctly states the vertical displacement as y = (U_2 * L_1^2) / (4 * d * U_1).

title: Total screen displacement
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) correctly states the total distance PO as (U_2 * L_1 * (L_1 + 2L_2)) / (4 * d * U_1).

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem (or conservation of energy) to relate the accelerating voltage U_1 to the electron's kinetic energy and initial speed.

title: Kinematics in field
description: Important: Correctly calculates the vertical acceleration (a = eE/m = eU_2/(md)) and uses kinematics (y = 1/2 a t^2) to find the displacement inside the plates.

title: Post-field motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the motion after the deflection plates, calculating the additional displacement y_2 using the vertical velocity at exit and the travel time to the screen.

title: Horizontal velocity constant
description: Important: Recognizes that the horizontal component of velocity remains constant after acceleration, as no horizontal force acts.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Demonstrates or implicitly maintains consistent units (e.g., SI) throughout the derivation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies the sign of the electron's charge in the force calculation (F = eE) or confuses the direction of deflection.

title: Kinematics misapplication
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses kinematics formulas (e.g., using v = at for displacement inside the plates instead of y = 1/2 at^2, or misidentifying the time of flight).
